text.description_html:
Thumbturn Mortise Cylinder, Corbin Russwin CR1303100A03613

Classroom function cylinders have a pin to block cam rotation in the locking direction. The pin may be installed on either side of the cam, depending on the hand of the door. This thumbturn cylinder is 1" long with an Adams Rite cam in oil rubbed bronze finish.

Features and Specifications of the Corbin Russian Thumbturn Mortise Cylinder CRS-CR100112A03:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Cylinder Length: 1"
  • Cam: Adams Rite

Sold Individually. Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS
